name: Mize
description: Logs every job application and shows which employers actually reply.
notes: Job cards warn you about low pay, too many hours and scam signs, and you can hide jobs or whole employers.
Your You page has a Ready to apply score, a weekly target, the law at your age and your firsts. Reminders tell you when to chase.
Forgot your password? Mize can now email you a sign-in code.
